statements.quote: Oracle’s capital investment program supports the pursuit of unprecedented opportunities in AI Cloud Infrastructure as described at our most recent Financial Analyst Meeting.
statements.notes: Present tense with no year. Read as describing the ongoing capital program, so recorded as actual for the reporting year; it could also be read as forward-looking. No capex amount is stated anywhere in the passages. The debt and equity financing figures ($43B and $5B raised in FY2026, about $40B expected in FY2027) are funding, not capex, so they are not recorded. The $75B of prepaid or customer-supplied GPUs is part of contract value, not Oracle capex, so it is not recorded either.

none_found.reason: no sentence quantifies or attributes research and development, infrastructure or headcount operating expenses to AI; 'operating efficiency actions' is not linked to AI
